results.title: OPAY U.S. IPO: What You Need to Know - The China-Global South Project
results.snippet:
Nigeria-based payments platform OPAY will become the second Chinese-backed African tech company this year to offer shares in international markets. The company plans to market 16 million American depositary receipts at $19 to $21 each, according to its filing last week with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

results.title: Solar Panels Are Now Wedding Gifts in Nigeria
results.snippet:

By the end of 2025, Bloomberg reported that small-scale solar capacity had surpassed electricity delivered by the national grid, and Nigeria had added as much solar capacity so far in 2026 as in 2024 and 2025 combined.
